description: This file contains Data Access Object (DAO) classes for managing Database entities and related OAuth2 tokens in the Superset project. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and validating databases, as well as handling SSH tunnels and related objects like charts and dashboards.

classes.name: DatabaseDAO
classes.description: DAO class for managing Database entities, including creation, retrieval, update, validation, and related object fetching.

classes.name: DatabaseUserOAuth2TokensDAO
classes.description: DAO class for managing OAuth2 tokens related to databases.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Database instance, optionally with an SSH tunnel if feature is enabled.

methods.name: find_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a Database by its ID, eagerly loading SSH tunnel relationship.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a Database, unmasking encrypted data and handling SSH tunnel updates.

methods.name: validate_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if a database name is unique.

methods.name: validate_update_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if a database name is unique for updates, excluding the current database ID.

methods.name: get_database_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a Database by its name.

methods.name: build_db_for_connection_test
methods.description: Constructs a Database object for testing connection, including SSH tunnel info.

methods.name: get_related_objects
methods.description: Fetches related charts, dashboards, and SQL Lab tab states for a given database.

methods.name: get_datasets
methods.description: Returns datasets (tables) filtered by catalog and schema for a specific database.
